description: "A Short Essay Toward the Improvement of Psalmody" by Isaac Watts is a theological treatise written in the early 18th century. This book focuses on the practice of singing in Christian worship, particularly how the Psalms of David should be adapted and translated into hymns suitable for contemporary church settings.
